# usage interval

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:usageInterval`](gmeow-usageInterval.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/usageInterval>
- **Category:** property
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/names`](../../slices/names.md)
- **Box roles:** [RBox role](../boxes/rbox.md) ([What is this?](../../four-boxes/index.md))

The time interval over which a name-usage held. (A relator carries its period this way — matching contacts' [`relationshipInterval`](gmeow-relationshipInterval.md) — rather than via [`duringInterval`](gmeow-duringInterval.md).)

## Structure

**Property shape:** object property; [`gmeow:NameUsage`](../classes/gmeow-NameUsage.md) -> [`gmeow:TimeInterval`](../classes/gmeow-TimeInterval.md)

## Practical Pattern

Use [`gmeow:usageInterval`](gmeow-usageInterval.md) from [`gmeow:NameUsage`](../classes/gmeow-NameUsage.md) to [`gmeow:TimeInterval`](../classes/gmeow-TimeInterval.md) when the relationship itself belongs in the native GMEOW graph.

## Common Companion Terms

[`gmeow:NameUsage`](../classes/gmeow-NameUsage.md), [`gmeow:TimeInterval`](../classes/gmeow-TimeInterval.md)

## Usage Advice

### Use when

- Use to carry the period over which a [`gmeow:NameUsage`](../classes/gmeow-NameUsage.md) held — a former, historical, or life-stage-scoped name use that needs an explicit interval.

### Avoid when

- Avoid [`gmeow:duringInterval`](gmeow-duringInterval.md) for a relator's own period (use this, matching contacts' [`relationshipInterval`](gmeow-relationshipInterval.md)) and avoid deleting a lapsed usage — set [`gmeow:displayable`](gmeow-displayable.md) false on a superseded name instead.

### How to use

- Point [`gmeow:usageInterval`](gmeow-usageInterval.md) at a [`gmeow:TimeInterval`](../classes/gmeow-TimeInterval.md); for a simple bearing without a full relator, carry validity with gmeow:validFrom/validUntil on the statement instead.

### Examples

- ex:usageFamily [`gmeow:usageInterval`](gmeow-usageInterval.md) ex:childhoodYears.
